title: Eco Green Solar CMS v2.4.4
summary: Mobile Field Cards Unclipped Names, Navigation Pin Icon, Card/List View Toggle & Tour Fixes
features: 📱 Unclipped Customer Names: Full customer names now display cleanly without awkward truncation or breaking on phone cards.
📍 Google Maps Location Pin: Replaced text links with a dedicated Google Maps navigation pin button that never breaks lines.
🗂️ Card vs List View Toggle: Added mobile & desktop switcher for Cards view (default) and high-density Compact List view.
🧭 Tour Modal Mobile Fix: Fixed button clipping and horizontal overflowing in guided tour on mobile screens.
📹 Direct Camera Video Recording: Direct video and photo recording from device camera for complaint attachments.
